limitations: Issue #5 / MJ-REQ-004 remains OPEN/PARTIAL; this slice adds real transport evidence for structured AI evaluation and fixes receive-channel handling for API routes, but does not close remaining operation-bound requirements.
The transport oracle is a real loopback TCP request-side half-close, not a live user, employer, ATS, or external network call.
Synthetic provider behavior proves request cancellation and history discard, not inference quality or provider acceptance.
The interrupted client transport does not provide a response-body assertion; the decisive oracle is observed disconnect plus empty persisted history.
Hosted checks and independent review remain NOT_RUN_BY_USER_POLICY.
